verdict.rationale: Figma publishes a pricing page that lists tier-gated features, such as "Advanced Dev Mode inspection and MCP Server," "Centralized admin tools," and "Unlimited files and projects for a single team." Its AI page also says AI credits can be bought for a team, either pay-as-you-go or by subscription. That shows some published tiering and AI-credit gating, but the evidence is fragmentary. missing for 10: explicit seat-type definitions (full/dev/collab seats) and their prices, a clear tier-by-tier price table, explicit mapping of which AI features are gated to which plan or seat, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement

citations.quote: Advanced Dev Mode inspection and MCP Server
Unlimited files and projects for a single team
Purchase AI credits for your whole team to share. Enable pay-as-you-go for flexibility or subscribe to save.
